title: Confirm your password
purpose: Reconfirm your identity before an account-sensitive action.
summary: Confirm your password before a sensitive account change, such as two-factor settings.

tasks.title: Confirm and continue
steps: Select [[Confirm]]. The action you started continues.

tasks.title: Use your authenticator instead
steps: Select [[Use authenticator app or code]], when you have one set up.

good_to_know: This asks for your current password, not a new one.
A confirmation counts as recent for five minutes.

items.label: Password
items.description: Required current password for this signed-in account; not a replacement password.

items.label: Confirm
items.description: Records a recent successful identity check and resumes the protected operation or returns to the application destination. Incorrect passwords keep it blocked; repeated attempts are rate limited.

items.label: Forgot your password?
items.description: Opens password recovery from the current-password field help.

items.label: Alternative options
items.description: When an enrolled code factor exists, Use authenticator app or code opens factor reauthentication while preserving the pending destination.

sections.title: Availability
paragraphs: Requires sign-in and an available password authentication method. Without a usable password, redirects to an available factor method; if no reauthentication method exists the request is denied. A stored pending operation can resume after success; a separate pending challenge is not required merely to open this page. MFA-sensitive operations require recent reauthentication; the default recent interval is five minutes.
